name: smb-team
description: Small business operations team: 4 domain experts (finance, revenue, compliance, operations) orchestrated by a business general manager for comprehensive business management

displayDescription.en: 4 domain experts orchestrated by a business GM: finance, revenue growth, customer compliance, and operations — covering every aspect of small business management
displayDescription.zh: 经营总管调度四位领域专家，覆盖财务、营收、客户合规和运营，小企业管理一站搞定

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 本月经营复盘：现金流、销售进展、客户满意度、团队状态。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Monthly business review: cash flow, sales, customer satisfaction, team status.

quickPrompts.zh: 本月经营复盘：现金流、销售进展、客户满意度、团队状态。
quickPrompts.en: Monthly business review: cash flow, sales, customer satisfaction, team status.

quickPrompts.zh: 工资快发了但现金可能不够，评估一下缺口和对策。
quickPrompts.en: Payroll is coming but cash might be tight — assess the gap and suggest actions.

quickPrompts.zh: 看下全盘业务健康：哪些该重点投入、哪些该收缩。
quickPrompts.en: Full business health check: where to invest, where to pull back.
